import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {build} from 'esbuild';
const sha=(b:Uint8Array|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const wire=<T>(value:T):T=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));

test('cardiac vein learner and review share four exact draft stops, source identities and smooth camera contract',async()=>{
 const base='public/atlas-runtime/head-neck/',bytes=readFileSync(base+'manifest.json');
 assert.equal(sha(bytes),'09189d13a033c9c251de2a21672b3d34fbc32fc743cdaf439bffa450e47ef34b');
 const learner=JSON.parse(bytes.toString()),review=JSON.parse(readFileSync('atlas-review/manifest.json','utf8'));
 assert.equal(learner.sourceCommit,'9fba9a1e24b6669aafd48e945d55fc0939d50ab2');assert.equal(review.revision,learner.sourceCommit);
 const inputs=JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+'source-inputs.json','utf8'));
 for(const path of ['lib/cardiac-venous-tour.ts','content/cardiac-venous-tour-pins.json','lib/regional-tours.ts']){
  const input=inputs.find((f:{path:string})=>f.path===path),imported=review.files.find((f:{path:string})=>f.path===path);
  assert(input&&imported,path);assert.equal(imported.sourceSha256,input.sha256);assert.equal(sha(readFileSync('atlas-review/'+path)),input.sha256);
 }
 const pins=JSON.parse(readFileSync('atlas-review/content/cardiac-venous-tour-pins.json','utf8'));
 assert.equal(sha(JSON.stringify(pins)),'e47f042b655e69987d04c4192ad1991b99d6cebab3f9ca089bd581f2aec94156');
 const compiled=await build({stdin:{contents:"export {cardiacVenousTour} from './atlas-review/lib/cardiac-venous-tour';export {bodyReviewMaterial} from './atlas-review/lib/body-review-material';export {parseBodyReviewResponse} from './atlas-review/lib/body-review-response';",resolveDir:process.cwd(),loader:'ts'},bundle:true,write:false,format:'esm',platform:'node'});
 const api=await import('data:text/javascript;base64,'+Buffer.from(compiled.outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64'));
 const js=learner.files.filter((f:{path:string})=>f.path.endsWith('.js')).map((f:{path:string;sha256:string})=>{const b=readFileSync(base+f.path);assert.equal(sha(b),f.sha256);return new TextDecoder().decode(b);}).join('\n');
 const tour=api.cardiacVenousTour;assert.equal(tour.status,'draft');assert.equal(tour.steps.length,4);assert.equal(tour.region,'thorax');
 assert.equal(tour.revision,'cardiac-venous-surface-orientation-v1');assert.equal(pins.entries.length,4);
 assert.deepEqual(tour.steps.map((s:{view:string})=>s.view),['anterior','left','posterior','anterior']);
 for(const [i,step] of tour.steps.entries()){
  assert(js.includes(step.caption));assert.equal(step.durationMs,14000);assert.equal(step.fadeOthers,true);
  assert.deepEqual(step.frameIds,i<3?[step.selectedId]:pins.entries.map((e:{id:string})=>e.id));
 }
 for(const entry of pins.entries){
  const packet=wire(await api.bodyReviewMaterial(entry.id));
  assert.equal(packet.approval,false);assert.equal(packet.status,'worksheet-not-submitted');
  const evidence=packet.guidedTours.find((e:{tour:{id:string}})=>e.tour.id===tour.id);assert(evidence);
  assert.deepEqual(evidence.tour,wire(tour));
  const byId=(a:{id:string},b:{id:string})=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
  assert.deepEqual([...evidence.structures].sort(byId),[...pins.entries].sort(byId));
  assert.equal(evidence.transitionMs,1800);assert.equal(evidence.transition,'quintic-orbit');assert.equal(evidence.separation,0);
  assert.deepEqual(await api.parseBodyReviewResponse(packet,entry.id),packet);
  for(const change of ['caption','omitted','registration','source','old-revision']){
   const altered=wire(packet),i=altered.guidedTours.findIndex((e:{tour:{id:string}})=>e.tour.id===tour.id);
   if(change==='caption')altered.guidedTours[i].tour.steps[0].caption='Altered';
   if(change==='omitted')altered.guidedTours.splice(i,1);
   if(change==='registration')altered.guidedTours[i].patientRegistered=true;
   if(change==='source')altered.guidedTours[i].structures[0].sources[0].sha256='0'.repeat(64);
   if(change==='old-revision')altered.guidedTours[i].tour.revision='foreign-revision';
   assert.equal(await api.parseBodyReviewResponse(altered,entry.id),null,change);
  }
 }
});
